role: Interface of the seed-world build: the world a 1.7.10 server has before its first tick, built from the seed alone (createSpawnPosition, initialWorldChunkLoad's 625 chunks with population, pending ticks, tile entities and the creatures performWorldGenSpawning constructs), for the overworld and, on first travel, the Nether and End spawn areas. Compared against out/java/seedworld/<name>/ from netherite.oracle.SpawnDump and SpawnDumpDim.

structs.name: sw_entity
structs.java: one entity row of SpawnDump's animals.jsonl: Entity.entityId (Det's SERVER range), entityUniqueID, posX/Y/Z, motionX/Y/Z, rotationYaw/Pitch, Entity.rand, the follow-range 'Random spawn bonus' modifier and its UUID, EntitySheep fleece colour, fire, EntityEnderCrystal.innerRotation, EntityItem's stack

structs.name: seedworld
structs.java: one WorldServer at world start: the chunk provider and structure maps (struct populate), Det's SERVER streams, World.rand, World.updateLCG, the provider's dimensionId, the spawn point, the constructed entities and Rows.blkHash over the build's writes

structs.name: SW_SHEEP..SW_CLASSES enum
structs.java: the entity classes the build constructs: EntitySheep, EntityPig, EntityChicken, EntityCow, EntityMooshroom, EntityItem, EntityVillager, EntityWitch, EntityDragon, EntityEnderCrystal

gpu: its former globals, function statics and lazily built tables are gone (lane/gpuenv, L2): per-environment state lives in struct env (csrc/engine/env.h), per-dimension state in the replay's dims, constant tables are built before main; csrc/tests/globals.sh lists what is left
line 168, struct seedworld: ents is a heap array grown by realloc (seedworld.c sw_new), not a fixed-capacity array
notes: Header only; see the seedworld.c record for the build's hazards. The build runs before the first tick, but serverreplay.c's sr_ensure_saved (line 4922) runs seedworld_init/seedworld_build lazily from a chunk load or unload callback inside a replay tick.
